nodes.label: claim-sources Sensor
nodes.rationale: Deterministic, advisory, document-provenance check over the Intent Capture deliverable SET (not per file), so scaffolding passes until a deliverable exists. It validates citation shape and resolution only, deliberately leaving to the adversarial reviewer the judgement of whether a cited source actually supports the claim. Its Markdown reading is bounded by an asymmetry rule: where full CommonMark is unaffordable, divergence must land as a false failure and never a false pass, so it may demand an unowed citation but must never let unsourced or invisible-tag content through.

nodes.label: Inline Source-Tag Register
nodes.rationale: Every substantive paragraph, list item and table row carries a [desc], [scope], [Q<n>], [memory:<id>] or [assumption] tag that must resolve: [desc]/[scope] match aidlc-state.md exactly, memory tags name a visible rule under the cited H2 of the active space's org/team/project files, question tags resolve to filled answers, [scope] only for a workflow-selected signal, [assumption] only inside the assumptions section, and retained assumptions must match an Assumption Confirmation answered exactly 'A. Accept assumptions'. A tag counts only when rendered as literal text, so a link reference definition silently degrades a tag to a link that grounds nothing.
